paragraph: Maja Kristin learned that her schools in Marin County sat at the bottom for state funding. She asked the Ross Valley School District to gather one hundred teachers from their K-8 schools. She told the district to give the teachers one thing she never had: a night off from lesson plans. She gave one million dollars in bonuses. The teachers wept in the gym. Some paid off cars. Others sat down for the first time in months.

seed.summary: When a local resident found out that her schools in an extremely wealthy Northern California county was at the bottom for state funding, she stepped up to make the difference.
